senses.gloss:
लल् {vI.v} {c1c} U. (ललति-ते) To play,
move about, sport, dally, frolic;
पनसफलानीव वानरा ललंति Mk. 8. 8;
गजकलभा इव बधुला ललामः 4. 28;
ललदजगरघरेकोटराणां Māl. 5. 15. {vII.v}
{c10c} U. or Caus. (लालयति-ते, लालित)
1 To cause to sport or play, caress,
fondle, coax, dandle; लालने बहवो
दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः । तस्मात्पुत्रं च
शिष्यं च ताडयेन्न तु लालयेत् ॥
Subhāṣ.; Ku. 5. 15.
--2 To desire.
{vIII.v} {c10c} U. (ललयति-ते)
1 To fondle;
Mk. 4. 28.
--2 To loll the tongue.
--3 To desire.

लल a.
1 Playful, sportive.
--2
Lolling.
--3 Wishing, desirous.
--Comp.
--जिह्व = ललज्जिह्व q. v.

लाला [लल्-णिच् अच् टाप्]
Saliva, spittle; Bh. 2. 9.
--Comp.
--भक्षः
N. of a hell.
--मेहः passing mucous
urine.
--स्रवः a spider.
--स्रावः {1} a
flow of saliva. {2} a spider.

ललत् a.
1 Playing, sporting.
--2
Shaking, flashing, moving about;
Māl. 5. 5.
--3 Lolling.
--Comp.
--जिह्व a. (ललज्जिह्व) {1} lolling the tongue.
{2} savage, fierce.
--(ह्वः) {1} a dog.
{2} a camel.

ललनं [लल्-ल्युट्]
1 Sport, play,
pleasure, dalliance.
--2 Lolling the
tongue.
--नः
1 A child.
--2 The Sāla
and Piyāla trees.

1 A woman(in general);
शठनाकलोकललनाभिरविरतरत रिरंससे
Śi. 15. 88.
--2 A wanton woman.
--3
The tongue.
--Comp.
--प्रियः the
Kadamba tree.

लालन a. (नी f.) Fondling,
coaxing, caressing.
--नः A sort of
poisonous mouse.
--नं [लल्-ल्युट्]
1
Caressing, fondling, coaxing;
सुतलालनं &c.
--2 Indulging,
over-indulgence, fondling too much; लालने
बहवो दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः;
Pt. 1. 169; Bh. 2. 42.

ललनिका A little or miserable
woman; Kāv. 3. 50.

1 A long necklace.
--2
A lizard or chameleon.
ललाकः The penis.

ललाटं [लड्-अच् डस्य लः, ललमटति
अट्-अण् वा Tv.] The forehead;
लिखितमपि ललाटे प्रोज्झितुं कः समर्थः H. 1. 21;
N. 1. 15.
--Comp.
--अक्षः an epithet
of Śiva.
--तटं the slope of the
forehead, the forehead itself.
--पट्टः,
--पट्टिका {1} the flat surface of the
forehead. {2} a tiara, fillet.
--रेखा {1} a
line on the forehead. {2} a wrinkled
brow. {3} a coloured sectarial mark
on the forehead.
--लेखा the line on
the forehead.

1 The forehead.
--2 A
beautiful forehead.

ललाटंतप a.
1 Burning or
scorching the (fore) head; ललाटंतपस्तपति
तपनः Māl. 1; U. 6 ‘the sun is
shining right overhead’; ललाटतपसप्तसप्तिः
R. 13. 41.
--2 (Hence) Very
painful; लिपिर्ललाटंतपनिष्ठुराक्षरा N. 1. 138.
--पः The sun.

1 An ornament worn on
the forehead.
--2 A mark made with
sandal or any other fragrant powder
on the forehead;
ललाटिकाचंदनधूसरालका Ku. 5. 55; भस्मललाटिका
K. 139; तेन रसेन ललाटिकामकल्पयम्
157.

लालाटिक a. (की f.) [ललाटं
प्रभोर्भाग्यं पश्पति ठञ्]
1 Being on or
relating to the forehead.
--2
Arising from or dependent on fate;
प्राप्तिस्तु लालाटिकी Udb.
--3 Useless;
low, vile.
--4 Attentive, vigilant.
--कः
1 An attentive servant (lit.
one who watches his master's
countenance and learns by it what is
necessary to be done).
--2 An idler,
a careless or useless person.
--3 A
kind of embrace.

ललाटूल a. Having a high or
handsome forehead.

ललाम a. (मी f.)
1 Beautiful,
lovely, charming.
--2 Having a mark on
the forehead marked with a blaze.
--मं
1 An ornament for the forehead,
an ornament or decoration in
general; (m. also in this sense); अहं तु
[]
तामाश्रमललामभूतां शकुंतलामधिकृत्य ब्रवीमि
Ś. 2; Śi. 4. 28.
--2 Anything the
best of its kind.
--3 A mark on the
forehead.
--4 A sign, symbol, mark
in general.
--5 A banner, flag.
--6 A
row, series, line.
--7 A tail.
--8
A mane.
--9 Eminence, dignity,
beauty.
--10 A horn.
--मः A horse.

ललामकं A chaplet of flowers worn
on the forehead.

ललामन् n.
1 An ornament, a
decoration.
--2 (Hence) Anything the
best of its kind; कन्याल लाम
कमनीयमजस्य लिप्सोः R. 5. 64 ‘the best
or ornament of girls’.
--3 A banner,
flag.
--4 A sectarial mark, token, sign,
symbol.
--5 A tail; see ललाम.

ललित a. [लल्-क्त]
1 Playing,
sporting, dallying.
--2 Amorous,
sportive, wanton, voluptuous.
--3
Lovely, beautiful, handsome,
elegant, graceful;
ललितललितैर्ज्योत्स्नाप्रायैरकृत्रिमविभ्रमैः (अंगकैः) U. 1. 20;
विधाय सृष्टिं ललितां विधातुः R. 6. 37,
19. 39; 8. 1; Māl. 1. 15;
Ku. 3. 75, 6. 45; Me. 32, 64.
--4 Pleasing,
charming, agreeable, fine; प्रियशिष्या
ललिते कलाविधौ R. 8. 6; संदर्शितेव
ललिताभिनयस्य शिक्षा M. 4. 9;
V. 2. 18.
--5 Desired.
--6 Soft, gentle,
Śi. 7. 64.
--7 Tremulous, trembling.
--तः N. of a musical scale.
--तं
1 Sport, dalliance, play.
--2
Amorous pastime, gracefulness of
gait; any languid or amorous gesture
in a woman; सुकुमारतयांगानां बिन्यासो
ललितं भवेत् S. D.; Śi. 9. 79;
Ki. 10. 52.
--3 Beauty, grace, charm.
--4 Any natural or artless act.
--5
Simplicity, innocence.
--Comp.
--अभिनय a. consisting of graceful
gesticulations or acting; V. 2. 18.
--अर्थ a. having a pretty or
amorous meaning; V. 2. 14.
--पद a. {1}
elegantly composed; Ś. 3. {2}
consisting of amorous words. ˚बंधनं an
amorous composition.
--प्रहारः a soft
or gentle blow.
--ललित a.
excessively beautiful; U. 1. 20.
--लुलित
a. unnerved yet charming; Māl. 1. 15.

1 A woman(in general).
--2 A wanton woman.
--3 Musk.
--4
A form of Durgā.
--5 N. of
various metres.
--Comp.
--पंचमी the
fifth day in the bright half of
Āśvina.
--सप्तमी the seventh day
[]
in the bright half of Bhādrapada.

लालित p. p.
1 Caressed, fondled,
coaxed, indulged.
--2 Seduced.
--3
Loved, desired.
--तं Pleasure, love,
joy.

लालक a. (नी f.) Fondling,
coaxing.

लालस a.
1 Ardently longing
for, eagerly desirous of, hankering
after; प्रणामलालसाः K. 14;
[]
ईशानसंदर्शनलालसानां Ku. 7. 56, Śi. 4. 6.
--2
Taking pleasure in, devoted to, fond
of, absorbed in; विलासलालसं Gīt. 1;
शोक˚, मृगया˚ &c.
--सः = लालसा. q. v.
below.

लालसा [लस् स्पृहायां यङ् लुक् भावे अ]
1 Longing or ardent desire,
extreme desire, eagerness.
--2 Asking,
solicitation, entreaty.
--3 Regret,
sorrow.
--4 The longing of a
pregnant woman (दोहद).

लालसीकं^1 Sauce.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: Cf. AP and SHS gives derivation with Ikan suffix..

लालायते Den. A. To emit saliva;
Pt. 4. 78.
लालाटी The forehead.

लालिकः A buffalo.
--का A
jesting reply.

लालितकः A fondling or darling,
pet, little favourite.

लालित्यं [ललितस्य भावः घञ्]
1
Loveliness, charm, beauty, grace,
sweetness; दंडिनः पदलालित्यं Udb.
--2
Amorous gestures.
लालिन् m. A seducer.
लालिनी A wanton woman.
लालुका A kind of necklace.
